messages.subject: Project Redwood – post-completion SDLT and registration
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Thank you again for getting Kingsgate House over the line. Could you confirm the SDLT return for the £18.5m purchase has been filed and that the application to register the transfer at the Land Registry is in? Our auditors are asking for the SDLT5 certificate for the year-end file. No urgency, but a note for the file would be helpful.

Best,
Isla Fournier
Head of Acquisitions, Thornbury Properties Limited
